statement: ∀ C : Set (Space n), IsCompact C → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ C ⊆ openBox (n := n) R
proof:
intro C hC
obtain ⟨R, hR, hb⟩ := hC.isBounded.exists_pos_norm_lt
refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
intro x hx j
apply abs_lt.mp
exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le x j) (hb x hx)
